Hi Samira,

Thanks for sending over the initial insurance packet and W9 — I’ve attached what you uploaded for quick reference. We reviewed the COI and W9 with Procurement and Legal. The COI shows general liability and workers comp but is missing a formal Additional Insured endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." and language that the coverage is primary and non-contributory. We also need confirmation of the cyber liability limit or evidence of an active cyber policy (EdgeWorks listed only a blanket entry on the COI).

To keep your activation moving, Procurement has agreed to a conditional purchase order for up to 30 days while your broker secures the endorsement, provided the following happens:
- You provide a broker contact and ETA for the Additional Insured endorsement (certificate endorsement form or endorsement PDF).
- If cyber liability exists, provide the policy limit or a broker letter confirming coverage details.
- Upload the finalized COI and endorsement to the vendor portal.

Can you confirm whether your broker can issue the endorsement within 10 business days? If so, I’ll request Procurement to hold the PO in conditional state and share a DocuSign link for a limited term PO. If it will be longer, let us know the timing so we can evaluate alternative mitigations.

Attachments: edgeworks_coi.pdf, edgeworks_w9.pdf

Thanks — I’m looping Marissa from Procurement on next steps.

—
Rishi Malhotra

Samira —

Appreciate the update and the broker contact. To make this formal and avoid rework, Procurement requires the following items before we can finalize activation (even if we consider a conditional PO):

Required (must be uploaded to the vendor portal):
1) Additional Insured endorsement naming: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents."
2) Endorsement or cover note explicitly stating coverage is "primary and non-contributory" for operations performed for Redwood.
3) Certificate holder section updated to: "Redwood Inference, Inc., 1209 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103" (this is standard).
4) Proof of cyber liability with explicit limits (minimum $1M required for this engagement). If cyber is part of a combined policy, submit broker letter specifying scope and limits.
5) Current W9 (we have this but thank you for re-sending).
6) Completed vendor onboarding form (I’ve attached the current procurement_checklist.xlsx so you can see the fields we need completed — legal entity, remit-to, contact for invoices, bank wiring instructions if applicable).

Notes on PO and timing:
- We can issue a conditional PO that covers initial onboarding activities (kick-off, SRE coordination, docs) for a 30-day window only if the broker confirms endorsement issuance within 10 business days and provides a statement of intent.
- If the endorsement cannot be guaranteed within that window, the PO will remain on hold until the endorsement is received.
- Please route the endorsement request directly to Rachel at Lighthouse (broker@lighthousebrokers.com) and cc procurement@redwood.com so we have paper trail.

Escalation path: if there is any delay beyond two weeks, please escalate to me and I will involve Legal (cc: karthik_iyer) to evaluate exception language.

Attachments: procurement_checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Thanks for the broker contact and the cyber policy confirmation. Per Marissa’s checklist, we’ll proceed with a provisional PO limited to 30 days to allow your team to begin onboarding tasks. Conditions are:

- Final endorsement PDF must be uploaded to the portal before provisioning of production credentials or any paid activity beyond initial onboarding.

I’m creating a limited-term PO and will route it through DocuSign once Legal confirms the exception language.
